stopReason: Both provider caps reached. No further paid expansion needed for a bounded first benefits cluster. Political/news events, state portal navigation and future state pages are excluded or folded into supported pages rather than forced into extra URLs.
remainingUncertainty: Snapshot not exhaustive. Provider Google redirect-heavy result-domain counts do not establish locked/winnable competition; explicit caveat retained.
